coreConclusion: 현재 시스템은 조합 후보와 일부 맵 경계를 잘 아는 추천기지만, 전투·경제·시간 상태를 충분히 관측하지 못해 솔로 악몽의 행동 코치라고 부를 수 없다. 안전한 모델은 고정 라운드 숫자보다 관측 상태와 맵의 실제 마감에 의해 전이해야 한다.

desiredGameplaySnapshotContract.fieldType: EvidenceValue<T> = {state: known|unknown|transient|unsupported, value?: T, provenance: map|memory|ocr|manual|derived, observedRevision: integer, observedMatchGeneration: integer}
desiredGameplaySnapshotContract.invariant: candidate action이 읽는 모든 field는 state=known, observedRevision==snapshot.recognitionRevision, observedMatchGeneration==snapshot.matchGeneration이어야 한다. firstRareObserved/firstLegendObserved는 현재 보유량이 아니라 matchGeneration 내 단조 false→true milestone이며, 두 번 확인된 새 generation에서만 false로 reset한다. 하나라도 불일치하면 false가 아니라 unknown이며 I-RECOGNITION으로 전이해 irreversible action을 막고 missing-signal 설명과 reversible action만 낸다.
desiredGameplaySnapshotContract.productionStatus: required contract only; current AdaptivePlanningInputSource does not implement combat/economy/growth fields

phaseModel.resolution: 각 snapshot에서 terminal priority→global interrupt priority→첫 번째 base guard 순으로 정확히 하나의 activeAction을 선택한다. 같은 priority의 story/navigation 충돌은 conflictTruthTable로 결정하고 나머지는 secondaryCauses/queuedBlockers로 보존한다. interrupt는 suspendedCommitment를 보존하고 clear되면 재평가 후 resume한다.

terminalTransitions.guard: lives<=0 or map-declared line defeat condition
outcome==defeat && round>50 && boss active && lineCount/cap evidence identifies concurrent overload
outcome==defeat && complete followed replay chain proves recognition_unknown|recipe_resource_dead_end|target_overcommit and no mechanic cause above matched
outcome==defeat and no evidence-gated cause matched
terminalTransitions.action: Record manual_stop_or_unknown as unknown defeat fallback

globalInterrupts.guard: snapshot coherence/stability/provenance required by candidate action is unknown|transient|unsupported
bossRound is known and current boss unresolved
globalInterrupts.action: use source-backed boss survival action; if ability coverage incomplete label unverified

globalInterrupts.guard: the earliest terminal boss/story/cap boundary has known infeasible projection OR required projection inputs are unknown close enough that no complete scan fits
globalInterrupts.action: terminal recovery outranks committed goal; preserve goal as suspendedCommitment
globalInterrupts.resume: only after feasibility becomes known-safe or boundary resolves

globalInterrupts.guard: lineCount and cap are known and next unresolved wave would meet/exceed map cap, or lives are at immediate overflow risk
globalInterrupts.action: deploy/clear/stop economy; never use an invented 80% threshold
globalInterrupts.resume: after post-action rescan proves risk cleared

globalInterrupts.guard: story reward pending, source-confirmed attack window expiring, or EggheadAppearance 120-second timed spawn event is next
globalInterrupts.action: claim/recompute for reward; use expiring attack window only if survival known-safe; for Egghead show spawn countdown and preparation, not a defeat claim
globalInterrupts.resume: apply/observe event, rescan, recompute exact deficits

globalInterrupts.action: show compatible option matrix and select before 24
globalInterrupts.resume: return to suspended build/story state after selection

globalInterrupts.action: display source-forced AlliedForces.DoubleBenefit, block fabricated user choice, and rescan actual state
globalInterrupts.resume: continue only from observed forced selection

conflictTruthTable.reason: known/unknown terminal feasibility outranks choice preservation

conflictTruthTable.primary: source-backed event whose irreversible loss occurs first
conflictTruthTable.tieBreak: terminal loss > R24 navigation forced-choice loss > nonterminal reward/spawn event
conflictTruthTable.reason: compare actual expiry, never a fixed heuristic

conflictTruthTable.primary: impossible for coherent round; route to I-RECOGNITION if observed

baseStates.action: show nearest exact rare recipe step; spend selectable wisp only for a proven missing leaf
compare exact remaining leaves and resource opportunity cost; wait only for a source-confirmed reward that reduces the deficit
advance story, spend stage7/8 rare rewards then rescan, incorporate stage9 Marineford reward before locking top
maintain exact top/support route while evaluating terminal and timed map events on every scan
prioritize measured story feasibility; show remaining stages/rounds without assuming 2R per stage
prepare 41R cap50 and 40/50R boss; after stage13 track EggheadAppearance 120-second spawn event separately from defeat deadlines
validate 32-second line clear plus 55/60/65 boss concurrently; no fabricated 60-second post50 timer

phaseModel.coverageInvariant: 유효 round 0..65와 matchGeneration별 단조 firstRareObserved/firstLegendObserved, story/navigation 상태는 terminal 또는 한 interrupt/base guard에 매핑된다. 여러 위험은 conflictTruthTable이 단일 action을 정하고 나머지를 queued blockers로 표시한다.
phaseModel.pre30BossExample: 30R 에넬 raw budget은 750000×3/60=37500 DPS per lane before skill/resistance corrections. I-HARD-BOUNDARY is evaluated before round30; current production round>=30 trigger is explicitly non-conforming.
phaseModel.bossUnknownRule: A04R/A04Q unmodeled와 A11S partial 때문에 exact clear guarantee와 boss별 invented control threshold를 금지한다.

desiredUrgencyContract.evaluation: stable snapshot마다 nextHardBoundary를 계산하며 round>=30 같은 늦은 단일 gate를 사용하지 않는다.
desiredUrgencyContract.activation: feasibility가 known-infeasible이면 즉시 recovery; required evidence가 unknown이고 boundary 전 추가 stable scan 여유가 없으면 fail-closed recovery/unknown 경고
desiredUrgencyContract.precedence: terminal recovery action > suspended committed goal > support tie-breakers
desiredUrgencyContract.singleCandidate: 재정렬 후보가 하나여도 unsafe/unknown reason과 missing signals를 유지
desiredUrgencyContract.resume: boundary가 해결되거나 feasibility가 known-safe가 되면 suspended goal을 새 inventory로 재평가해 resume 또는 robust pivot
desiredUrgencyContract.productionDelta: 현재 RecommendationUrgencyPolicy의 round<30 early return과 goal-id priority 0은 이 계약에 미달하며 구현 과제로 남음

localEphemeralChain.binding: 프로세스 메모리의 단일 pending decision만 허용한다. UI action/acknowledgement는 전송되지 않는 localDecisionSequence에 결합하고, inferred action은 sequence를 확정할 수 없으면 adherence=unknown이다. 정확히 해당 pending sequence 이후의 첫 coherent stable rescan/result만 결합한다.
localEphemeralChain.collisionPolicy: pending chain이 미완료면 같은 우선순위의 새 recommendation display를 억제한다. 더 높은 priority interrupt가 supersede하면 기존 chain을 incomplete+adherence=unknown+reason=superseded로 닫고 baseline stable rescan 전 execution 관측을 격리한 뒤 새 sequence를 연다. 앱 종료/판 경계/timeout은 incomplete+unknown으로 expire한다.
localEphemeralChain.persistence: match aggregate 생성 후 sequence와 원시 chain을 폐기하며 sequence/ordered trace는 디스크 또는 원격에 저장하지 않음

remoteAggregate.status: desired extension; deployed telemetry v2 currently lacks action/adherence/post-scan buckets

failureReviewContract.fieldVsSimulator: field aggregate와 simulator replay를 별도 표로 유지하고 결합 승률을 만들지 않음
failureReviewContract.attributionRule: 동일 localDecisionSequence의 displayed→explicitly bound executed→coherent post-action stable rescan→result chain이 완성되고 adherence=followed일 때만 추천 결과로 귀속한다. inferred/expired/superseded/collision chain은 항상 recommendation-causality unknown
failureReviewContract.privacyBoundary: 식별자 없는 집계 v2 원칙을 유지하며 원시 행동 chain은 전송·영구 저장하지 않음
